description: List the saved connectors in your workspace: each names one bot a digital test can talk to, with an id, name, description, type (connect-chat, http-json, web-widget, lex-v2 or direct-line), targetRef (the stable name reports group runs by) and the connection settings for that type. A connector holds no password or secret: an http-json connector names a stored credential by reference only. Takes optional `type`, `limit` (1 to 200, default 50) and `cursor`. Use when: the user asks which bots are set up, or you need the targetRef of a bot to filter listDigitalTestRuns or read getDigitalComplianceAudit. Read-only. Needs digital:read.

cursor.description: Opaque base64 cursor from `nextCursor` in a previous response.

limit.description: Rejected with 400 outside 1-200 rather than silently clamped.

type.description: Filter to one connector type. An unknown type is a 400, not an empty list.

name: listDigitalConnectors

outputSchema.description: One page of connectors, most recently updated first.

config.description:
The target object minus `transport`. Validated against the schema for
`type` — see `GET /digital-testing/connector-types` for the fields each
type accepts.

targetRef.description:
Immutable after creation — the stable key compliance reports aggregate
on. Renaming a connector must never split its report history.

type.description: Immutable after creation — determines every field in `config`.

typeUpdatedAt.description: Derived range key (`{type}#{updatedAt}`). Never accepted from a caller.

nextCursor.description:
Opaque base64 cursor. Present ONLY when another page exists, and OMITTED
(not null) on the last page.

title: List Digital Connectors
